description: A locked field an invariant reads, given a call of a pure `fn` of compile-time constants at a use site (`<w b=(dbl(2))/>`): accepted (the value tracks nothing; the construction check holds it).
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-derived-split: "a field that tracks a cell or a live use-site value stays refused, PERMANENT, E-CONTRACT-003" — a pure call of constants tracks nothing.
